description: AAASM-5344 bypass guard: a synthetic ASCII high-entropy secret sitting flush against Chinese text on both sides is still detected. Fixing the CJK false positive by dropping any whitespace token that holds a non-ASCII byte would have made one prepended glyph a universal evasion, so the entropy pass must segment the token into ASCII runs and score each run. The secret carries an interior '.', which keeps both of its base64 sub-runs under the 20-char contiguous-run floor — only the run-segmented token pass can catch it, so this vector fails if that pass stops looking inside a mixed-script token.
